hook.text: A restaurant on a highway serves bad food. A restaurant in your town can't afford to. The difference is reputation.

buildup.text: Reputation turns one-shot games into repeated games: others watch your past and predict your future behavior.

discovery.text: Even a small chance that you're cooperative changes the game: rational players cooperate to maintain reputation.

twist.text: Final moves are dangerous: retiring CEOs, lame-duck presidents, and last-day employees lose reputation incentives.

climax.text: Online review systems harness reputation to enable trust between strangers. Uber, eBay, Airbnb all depend on it.

punchline.text: Your record speaks before you do.

quiz.question: Why do reputation effects promote cooperation?
options: Past behavior predicts future treatment from others
